newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Arafat calls for pressure on Israel at OAU summit.
newsitem.headline: Arafat calls for pressure on Israel at OAU summit.

text.p: Palestian President Yasser Arafat called on Monday for more international pressure on Israel to resume stalled Middle East peace talks.
In an address to an Organisation of African Unity summit in Zimbabwe, Arafat appealed to the 53-member OAU to support the PLO against what he called "the expropriation of Palestine land".

"I would like to assure you of our commitment to negotiations and peace to ensure the rights of our people. We invite you to urge Israel to commit itself to the attainment of peace and stop the expropriation of Palestine land," he said.
PLO officials say Arafat is at the three-day OAU summit to lobby for diplomat support to try to get back the Middle East peace process back onto the rails.

The PLO has a permanent observer status in the OAU and Arafat has attended its previous summits, winning in the process solid backing for his political positions. But the OAU has very little influence in Middle East politics.
Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations have been deadlocked for more than two months mainly over Israel's building of new Jewish homes in Arab East Jerusalem.
